name: setup
goal: Set up Patchlane for this fork, publish only the configured patch refs, leave the base branch unchanged, and leave generated sync output unpublished.
preferences: Use the existing upstream remote and its main branch.
Keep the existing CI workflow and fork customization on focused patch branches.
Use Patchlane’s default GitHub App wiring.

authorization.description: Apply the complete setup plan and publish only the configured patch refs to origin.

prohibitions: Do not change files, branches, remotes, credentials, or settings before approval.
Do not publish the generated integration output.
Do not change the base branch.
